set(_SRC ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})

# man2hlp is generated by src/man2hlp; we depend on that target.
# The top-level man page is generated in doc/man.
set(_man1 "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/doc/man/mc.1")
set(_xnc "${_SRC}/doc/hlp/xnc.hlp")
set(_hlp_out "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mc.hlp")
set(_man2hlp "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/src/man2hlp/man2hlp")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${_hlp_out}"
    COMMAND ${PERL} "${_man2hlp}" "${_man1}" "${_xnc}" "${_hlp_out}"
    DEPENDS "${_man1}" "${_xnc}" "${_man2hlp}"
    COMMENT "Generating mc.hlp via man2hlp"
    VERBATIM)

add_custom_target(hlp ALL DEPENDS "${_hlp_out}")
add_dependencies(hlp man-pages)

install(FILES "${_hlp_out}"
    DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/${MC_PACKAGE}/help")

# Translated help files: es hu it pl ru sr
set(_hlp_linguas es hu it pl ru sr)
foreach(_lang ${_hlp_linguas})
    if(EXISTS "${_SRC}/doc/hlp/${_lang}/xnc.hlp")
        # Translated hlp uses translated man page if available
        set(_t_man1 "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/doc/man/${_lang}/mc.1")
        if(EXISTS "${_SRC}/doc/man/${_lang}/mc.1.in")
            set(_hlp_lang_out "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/mc.hlp.${_lang}")
            set(_xnc_lang "${_SRC}/doc/hlp/${_lang}/xnc.hlp")
            add_custom_command(
                OUTPUT "${_hlp_lang_out}"
                COMMAND ${PERL} "${_man2hlp}" "${_t_man1}" "${_xnc_lang}" "${_hlp_lang_out}"
                DEPENDS "${_t_man1}" "${_xnc_lang}" "${_man2hlp}"
                COMMENT "Generating mc.hlp.${_lang} via man2hlp"
                VERBATIM)
            add_custom_target(hlp-${_lang} ALL DEPENDS "${_hlp_lang_out}")
            add_dependencies(hlp-${_lang} man-page-${_lang})
            add_dependencies(hlp hlp-${_lang})
            install(FILES "${_hlp_lang_out}"
                DESTINATION "${CMAKE_INSTALL_DATADIR}/${MC_PACKAGE}/help"
                RENAME "mc.hlp.${_lang}")
        endif()
    endif()
endforeach()
